title: At the butcher's / He likes ... but he doesn't ...
subtitle: 在肉铺 / 他喜欢……但他不喜欢……

lead.question: 你去肉铺买肉，摊主问你「要牛肉还是要羔羊肉？」——你会怎么用英语点肉，又怎么用 but 带出「我喜欢……可我家那位不喜欢」？
lead.warmup: 先别看课文。想象你在肉铺：摊主问你要不要肉、要牛肉还是羔羊肉。中文说「一块牛排、一磅绞肉」，英文里 meat/beef/lamb/chicken 这些不可数，要借 a piece of / a pound of 表数量。重点还有一句 I like lamb, but my husband doesn't. —— but 把「我喜欢」和「他不喜欢」连成对照，句末的 doesn't 替掉了 doesn't like lamb，避免重复。第 50 课就把这种「He likes … but he doesn't (want any).」的对照句反复操练，把卷心菜、莴苣、豌豆、香蕉等挨个填进去。
goals: 能用 Do you want any …? / Do you want beef or lamb? 在店里买肉、点单
能用选择疑问句（or 连接）在有限选项里做选择，不用 yes/no 简单回答
能用 I like …, but he doesn't. 表达「我喜欢……但他不喜欢」的对照
区分 too（肯定句末「也」）与 either（否定句末「也」）
lead.summary: 第 49 课是肉铺场景：肉商问伯德夫人要牛肉还是羔羊肉，她说要牛肉和一块牛排、一磅绞肉，不要鸡，因为她丈夫喜欢牛排却不喜欢鸡；肉商也补一句「说老实话，我也不喜欢鸡」。全课用选择疑问句和 but 连接的对照句。第 50 课把 He likes X, but he doesn't (want any). 这种「喜欢却不想要」的句型反复操练，巩固第三人称单数与否定缩略。
lead.tips: ① 选择疑问句 Do you want beef or lamb? 不能用 Yes/No 回答，要直接选一项（Beef, please.）；② but 前后是两个并列分句，I like lamb, but my husband doesn't. 中 doesn't = doesn't like lamb，省略避免重复；③ too 用于肯定句末表「也」，either 用于否定句末表「也」（I don't like chicken either!）；④ What about some steak? 中 What 可换 How，用来征求看法；some 用在希望得到肯定回答的邀请句里；⑤ a pound of mince 一磅绞肉，不可数名词借量词。

questions.hint: 听 My husband likes steak, but he doesn't like chicken.

questions.q: What does Mrs. Bird buy at the butcher's?
questions.zh: 伯德夫人在肉铺买了什么？
questions.a: Beef, a piece of steak, and a pound of mince.
questions.aZh: 牛肉、一块牛排和一磅绞肉。
questions.hint: Beef, please. / Give me that piece. / a pound of mince

questions.q: Does Mrs. Bird want a chicken? Why not?
questions.zh: 伯德夫人要买鸡吗？为什么不要？
questions.a: No, thank you. Because her husband likes steak, but he doesn't like chicken.
questions.aZh: 不要，谢谢。因为她丈夫喜欢牛排，但不喜欢鸡。
questions.hint: My husband likes steak, but he doesn't like chicken.

questions.q: What does the butcher say about chicken at the end?
questions.a: To tell you the truth, I don't like chicken either!
questions.aZh: 说老实话，我也不喜欢鸡！
questions.hint: 句末用 either，因为是否定句。

questions.q: Why does the butcher say 'either' and not 'too' at the end of his sentence?
questions.zh: 肉商句末为什么用 either 而不是 too？
questions.a: either is used at the end of a negative sentence to mean '也'; too is used in positive sentences. The butcher's sentence is negative (I don't like chicken), so either is correct.
questions.aZh: either 用于否定句末表「也」；too 用于肯定句。肉商这句话是否定的（I don't like chicken），所以用 either。
questions.hint: 看句子是肯定还是否定。

questions.q: He likes coffee, but I don't. / She likes tea, but he doesn't. / He likes cabbage, but he doesn't want any.
questions.zh: 第 50 课操练：用 He/She likes X, but he/she doesn't (want any). 造对照句。
questions.a: He likes apples, but he doesn't want any.
questions.aZh: 他喜欢苹果，但他不想要（任何）。
questions.hint: but 连接两个对照分句；doesn't 替掉 doesn't like/want。

meanings.usage: 不可数；a pound of mince 一磅绞肉

To tell you the truth, I don't like chicken.

drill.q: He / She likes ___, but he / she doesn't want any.
drill.zh: 他/她喜欢……但他/她不想要（任何）。（把下列蔬菜填进横线，操练 but 连接的对照句与第三人称单数否定）
answers: He likes cabbage, but he doesn't want any.
She likes pears, but she doesn't want any.

exercises.q: 汉译英：您今天要买点肉吗，伯德夫人？
exercises.a: Do you want any meat today, Mrs. Bird?
exercises.note: any 用于疑问/否定；today 今天。

exercises.q: 把 Do you want beef? 改成「牛肉还是羔羊肉」的选择疑问句。
exercises.a: Do you want beef or lamb?
exercises.note: or 连接两项选择，读升调+降调，不能 yes/no 回答。

exercises.q: 汉译英：我喜欢羔羊肉，可我丈夫不喜欢。
exercises.a: I like lamb, but my husband doesn't.
exercises.note: but 连接对照；doesn't = doesn't like lamb，省略避免重复。

exercises.q: 填空：I don't like chicken ___ .（否定句末的「也」）
exercises.note: either 用于否定句末表「也」；too 用于肯定句。

exercises.q: 汉译英：来点牛排吗？这块很好。
exercises.a: What about some steak? This is a nice piece.
exercises.note: What about …? 征求看法，可换 How about；some 用于邀请。

exercises.q: 第 50 课：He likes cabbage, but he ___ want any.（否定）
exercises.note: 第三人称单数否定用 doesn't，后接动词原形 want。

exercises.a: To tell you the truth, I don't like chicken either.
exercises.note: to tell (you) the truth 句首插入语；否定句末用 either。

quiz.note: 选择疑问句要在所给选项里选一项，不能用 Yes/No 简单回答。

options: I don't like chicken as well.
quiz.note: either 用于否定句末；too/also/as well 用于肯定句。

quiz.q: What about some steak? 中的 What 可以换成：
quiz.note: What about …? 可换 How about …? 用来征求意见。

quiz.q: To tell you the truth 的意思是：
quiz.note: to tell (you) the truth 是句首插入语，意为「老实说/说实话」。

quiz.q: My husband doesn't. 中的 doesn't 代替了：
quiz.note: 省略句中 doesn't 替掉前面的 doesn't like lamb，避免重复。

quiz.q: 「来点牛排吗？这块很好」正确说法是：
options: What about some steak? This is a nice piece.
What about any steak? This is a nice piece.
quiz.note: 邀请、希望得到肯定回答时用 some 不用 any；steak 不可数不加 s。

grammar.title: 选择疑问句（Alternative questions）
grammar.structure: 一般疑问句 + or + 另一选项？
grammar.definition: 含 or 的问句叫选择疑问句。or 前的部分读升调，后的部分读降调。它把选择范围缩小在数目有限的选项上，不能用简单的 Yes/No 回答，要直接选一项作答。
grammar.usage: Beef or lamb? / Which would you prefer, tea or coffee? / How shall we go, by bus or by train?

examples.en: Do you want beef or lamb?
examples.zh: 您要牛肉还是要羔羊肉？

examples.en: Is it cold or warm in autumn?

grammar.title: 一般现在时第三人称单数（含 but 对照）
grammar.structure: 主语(单三) + 动词 -s/-es + …；否定：doesn't + 动词原形
grammar.definition: 一般现在时陈述习惯、喜好与永恒事实；当主语是 he/she/it 时，动词要加 -s 或 -es。否定与疑问借助 does/doesn't，后接动词原形。but 可连接两个对照的分句，后一分句常用 doesn't 省略重复内容。
grammar.usage: I like lamb, but my husband doesn't. (= doesn't like lamb)

examples.en: My husband likes steak, but he doesn't like chicken.
examples.zh: 我丈夫喜欢牛排，但他不喜欢鸡。

examples.en: He likes coffee, but I don't.
examples.zh: 他喜欢咖啡，但我不喜欢。

grammar.title: too 与 either（句末的「也」）
grammar.structure: 肯定句末 + too；否定句末 + either
grammar.definition: too 用于肯定句末（常带逗号）表「也」；either 用于否定句末（常带逗号）表「也」。两者位置都在句末，不能混用。
grammar.usage: I like lamb, too. / I don't like chicken either!

examples.en: He doesn't like the house, and I don't, either.
examples.zh: 他不喜欢这房子，我也不喜欢。

examples.en: I don't like chicken either!

phrases.usage: 征求看法或意见（What 可换 How）

examples.en: What about some steak?

phrases.usage: 老实说，说实话（句首插入语）

examples.en: To tell you the truth, I don't like chicken either!

phrases.usage: 一磅（量词，后接不可数名词）

examples.en: And a pound of mince, too.

phrases.usage: 一块（量词，后接不可数/单数）

examples.en: This is a nice piece.
